# Contributing

Thanks for taking the time to contribute to this project!

Before contributing, please read the [Code of Conduct](../CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).
For security vulnerabilities, please follow the instructions in the
[Security Policy](../SECURITY.md) instead of opening a public issue.

To set up your local development environment, build the debug APK, and run
tests on your device, please read the
[Local Development Guide](../Documentation/development.md).

Please check existing issues and pull requests before starting work to
avoid duplicate contributions.

When making changes, please keep your commits focused and use clear,
descriptive commit messages. Commit messages should follow this format:

    <type>: <description>

For example:

    feat: add background service notification

Common types include:

- `feat`: add a new feature
- `fix`: fix a bug
- `docs`: documentation changes
- `refactor`: code changes that do not fix a bug or add a feature
- `test`: add or update tests
- `chore`: maintenance changes

Please keep the description short, clear, and written in the imperative
mood when possible.

After making and testing your changes, open a Pull Request and follow the
[Pull Request Template](PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md).

Please keep Pull Requests focused on a specific change and avoid unrelated
modifications.

When reporting a bug, provide enough information to reproduce the issue,
including the affected version, environment, expected behavior, and actual
behavior.

Thank you for contributing!
